name: BalanceWheel
description:
Push one tonal range towards a colour: the hue is the direction and the distance from the centre
is how far. The value stays the develop filter's red, green and blue offsets, so recipes are
unchanged; `wheelToBalance` and `balanceToWheel` convert between the two.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onValueCommitted, size, variant, disabled, labels, "aria-label": label, className }: BalanceWheelProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name, such as the tonal range. Defaults to "Colour balance".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ develop: string; basic: string; toneCurve: string; hsl: string; colourBalance: string; detail: string; levels: string; exposure: string; brightness: string; contrast: string; highlights: string; shadows: string; whites: string; blacks: string; temperature: string; tint: string; saturation: string; vibrance: string; hue: string; clarity: string; texture: string; dehaze: string; autoEnhance: string; reset: string; channel: string; rgb: string; red: string; green: string; blue: string; range: string; orange: string; yellow: string; aqua: string; purple: string; magenta: string; midtones: string; inputBlack: string; gamma: string; inputWhite: string; outputBlack: string; outputWhite: string; addPoint: string; removePoint: string; point: string; input: string; output: string; before: string; after: string; comparison: string; histogram: string; luminance: string; pixels: string; colour: string; error: string; }> | undefined

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Final offsets, once per gesture or key press.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled red, green and blue offsets, each -100 to 100; [0,0,0] is neutral.

props.name: variant
props.description: `disc` (default) shows the colour itself; `ring` is quieter where several wheels sit together.
